what: Each line is covered on the right by a dark background-color gradient band (130% of the line width), which shrinks scaleX 1→0 around its right edge while the line resolves 0→1 — .05s stagger .3s power2. The text shows through from the band’s lighter left side, so each line appears sweeping from left to right. With look: band the line stays as is and a solid band of line height turns transparent (same stagger and length) and clears together with the gradient — a band that hid the intro text over the photo

options.dur: Length of one line (seconds), default .3 — Work detail end list in Brand A is .4
options.start: ScrollTrigger start (default ‹top 30%›, once) · load (immediately) · event (when fx:play is fired on the panel — after the loader lifts)
options.at: (optional) CSS for another element to measure the start from — bottom edge of the section before the list (‹at: .layout; start: bottom 30%」)
options.look: With band, a solid strip at line height turns transparent and clears (the line stays)
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Lines to reveal — band ([data-fx-part=gradient]·band) are created by the part if missing
options.--fx-band · --fx-reach: Band color and gradient width (css), default --kf-bg · 130% (100% for the intro text band)

note: To lay a band over difference-blended text, set the band color to black (the value that changes nothing in blending) and use look: band — the band must vanish so the white text shows inverting the background

from.where: index.html .home-intro-lines (17-line band covering the intro text after the loader — look: band, start: event) · .home-footer-top (contact row, when the panel head is at 30% of the screen) · detail.html .project-index (end list — at: .project-layout; start: bottom 30%; dur: .4)
